title: PM–Eng 1:1 prep — API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Goal for this 1:1: quick sync on high-priority rollout items so we can unblock the Dedicated beta customers, align on Console dashboard changes for the next release, and confirm Private deployment onboarding for ACME Corp. Keep this tight — 30 minutes.

Agenda (30 min)
- Quick status (5m): how the last week went, blockers
- Dedicated beta (10m): capacity, autoscale policy, SLA language for beta customers
- Console dashboards (8m): landing page metrics, per-route latency breakdown, token-cost drilldown
- Private onboarding (5m): ACME timeline, network/KMS questions, packaging for air-gapped install
- Quick actions & next steps (2m)

Notes / talking points
1) Status/Blockers
- Recent infra flakiness on g4dn pools — SRE is looking into kernel-level driver patch (see Slack thread). Impact so far: 5% error spike during hourly batch jobs last Wednesday.
- Customer bug from hosted API: streaming responses occasionally truncate when function-calling is enabled; reproduced locally with small seq-len variation. Filed PLAT-789. Dev triage ongoing.

2) Dedicated beta update (main concern)
- Beta cohort: 3 customers (ACME, DataFlow, NovaMetrics). Throughput targets: 800 reqs/min with p95 latency < 450ms for seq<=512.
- Autoscale policy prototype: warm pool size + burst buffer. Current config: min 2 nodes, max 10 nodes, scale-step 2. Observed underprovisioning at 700 reqs/min during peak due to slow node spin-up (~90s).
- Options: reduce spin-up by pre-warmed placeholder instances (cost increase) OR tighten request routing to prefer warm pool. Need tradeoff numbers.
- SLA language for beta customers — short-term ask from Sales: provide expected latency range and best-effort vertical scaling until GA. Draft SLA snippet in Confluence page.

3) Console changes (next release)
- Landing page: product wants a 1-line health indicator + quick actions (switch model, rollback). Engineering concerned about query cost for aggregated metrics. We can add cached snapshot updated every 30s instead of live-heavy queries.
- Per-route dashboards: add token-cost breakdown per route and quick filter by model variant. UX asks for top-3 expensive prompts to surface.
- Tracing: add link from error spike to raw request IDs (privacy-safe) — need SRE sign-off for retention window (current 7 days).

4) Private onboarding (ACME)
- ACME needs on-prem package + HSM integration. Security asked for dedicated KMS connector (customer-managed). Implementation details: support for AWS CloudHSM + optional PKCS#11 adapter for on-prem HSMs.
- Timeline: they want a test environment by end of next sprint (2 weeks). Engineering risk: packaging automation for air-gap currently blocked by installer signing doc (SEC-241).
- Action: need to prioritize a small "installer sign-off" task or provide a manual runbook as stopgap.

Open questions I want your view on
- Dedicated autoscaling: prefer invest in faster node spin-up (infra) or smarter routing + better warm pool sizing (platform)? Thoughts on cost tradeoffs if we pre-warm 2–3 extra nodes for each customer?
- Console caching cadence: 30s vs 60s vs event-driven snapshots — what feels safe without increasing query load?
- Private: is a manual installer runbook acceptable short-term for enterprise onboarding, or should we push to unblock SEC-241 first?

Proposed action items (who / when)
- Sam: follow up with SRE about g4dn driver patch ETA and share summary in #eng-platform by EOD (JIRA: SRE-982) — due 2026-03-04
- Maya: draft short SLA snippet for Dedicated beta and share with Sales & Legal for quick review (Confluence link) — due 2026-03-05
- Kai: spike on warm-pool pre-warm cost (estimate $/hr) + simulation for 2 extra nodes per beta customer; present numbers in next sync — due 2026-03-09 (JIRA: DED-412)
- Sam & Eng: add cached landing snapshot to Console (30s) as experiment; monitor query reduction — PR #1234 opened, need review from @oliver — due 2026-03-10
- Sam: prepare manual installer runbook for ACME and include KMS connector notes; share with Solutions Eng for validation — due 2026-03-06 (linked doc draft).

Follow-up items to track in 1:1s
- Autoscale decision (pre-warm vs routing) — target final decision by 2026-03-16
- Console dashboard perf after caching — check metrics 1 week after deploy
- ACME private install smoke test status — confirm test env by 2026-03-13

Misc quick notes
- Ticket refs: PLAT-789 (streaming truncation), DED-412 (warm pool cost spike analysis), SEC-241 (installer signing), SRE-982 (driver patch).
- Slack refs: #eng-platform and #customer-onboarding threads for ACME.
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/1234 (console snapshot), PR 1240 (kms-adapter spike).

Prep reminders for the meeting
- Bring the rough cost numbers for pre-warm (Kai)
- Have a short one-slide view of the Dedicated beta SLA language (Maya)
- Be ready to propose a temporary manual runbook for ACME (Sam)

Notes after the 1:1 (empty for now — will paste highlights and agreed actions)
summary: 1:1 prep notes for PM (Sam Lee) with agenda, blockers, Dedicated beta, Console caching, Private onboarding for ACME, open questions, and clear action items with owners and due dates.
